info.title: API.SH: Cdiscount
info.description: The Cdiscount API from API.SH: public Cdiscount data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Customer reviews of one Cdiscount product: rating, text, author nickname, date, order date, helpful votes, verified-purchase and tester flags, per-criterion ratings, photos and the seller's reply, with the overall rating, star breakdown and criteria averages. Sort and filter by stars like the site. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cdiscount-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product id or its cdiscount.com link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with these stars: 1-5, or several separated by commas (e.g. 4,5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search cdiscount.com (France): products with price, price before tax, eco tax, rating, review count, condition, seller (Cdiscount or a marketplace seller), free shipping and fulfilment flags, image and labels, plus every facet the shop offers for the query (category, brand, price band, delivery options, technical attributes) with result counts. Filter with facet value ids from `facets` and sort by relevance, price, sales or rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cdiscount-search

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, bestsellers (last 7 days), bestsellers_14d, rating.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet value ids from `facets[].values[].id`, separated by ; (or a JSON array), e.g. Marque/"apple";Livraison/"livraison gratuite".

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Cdiscount marketplace seller's shop: name, description, where it ships from, rating with star breakdown, review and sales counts, and the company details the shop publishes (company name, legal form, SIRET, VAT number, addresses, customer service email and phone) and its terms.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cdiscount-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller id (e.g. 50849, from a product's `seller.id`) or its cdiscount.com/mpv-<id>-<name>.html link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
